characters: Production 8-bit pixel art asset sheet for a cute sweet potato farming defense game. Strict square pixels, limited muted palette cream #fff4c7, deep green #28382b, leaf #63864d, potato purple #9e6381, gold #e9bd55. NO text, NO labels, NO grid lines, NO gradients, NO smooth shading. Exactly 6 columns and 5 rows equal cells, 30 separate front-facing full body sweet potato heroes centered with large margins, pure magenta #ff00ff background for chroma key. Each character has potato shaped purple or tan body, black pixel eyes, short feet. Row 1: sprout, honey pot hat, pink ribbon, flame hat, green leaves, strawberry hat. Row 2: cloud hat, crescent moon, sun crown, snowflake, royal crown, wizard hat. Row 3: pirate hat, chef hat, painter beret, musical note, book hat, explorer hat. Row 4: astronaut, star crown, cherry blossom, mushroom cap, frog hood, cat ears. Row 5: dog ears, rabbit ears, carrot hat, mint leaves, chocolate hat, rainbow crown. Unified camera scale. Each design fits entirely within its own cell. No shadows on backdrop.
